name: T1000 Ultra Smart Watch – Big Screen Fitness Tracker (7-in-1 Edition)
description:
Size: 49mm

Strap Material: Silica Gel

Display: 2.01" LCD (320 × 385) Full Touch Screen

Bluetooth: BT 3.0 / 4.0 / 5.0 (supports Bluetooth calling)

Charging Mode: Wireless Charging

Colors Available: Black, Silver, Orange

Battery Capacity: 220mAh

Body Material: Zinc Alloy

Watch Functions:

Call Functions:

Bluetooth Dialing

Contact List

Call Log & Caller ID

Answer / Reject Calls

Motion Monitoring:

Pedometer (time, distance, calories)

Sports Modes: Walking, Running, Climbing, Cycling, Indoor Running

Health Monitoring:

Heart Rate

Blood Pressure

Blood Oxygen (SpO₂)

Sleep Monitoring

Sedentary Reminder

Drinking Water Reminder

Breathing Exercises

Smart Reminders:

Caller ID & Call Alerts

Message / App Notifications

Additional Functions:

Raise Wrist to Wake Screen

Low Power Mode & Silent Mode

Anti-Lost Function

Remote Camera Control

Music Control

Stopwatch

Alarm Clock

Calendar

Calculator

Supported Languages:

English, Dutch, French, Arabic, German, Indonesian, Italian, Malaysian, Spanish, Russian, Vietnamese, Czech, Turkish, Polish, Portuguese, Thai

Package Includes:

1 × Smart Watch

1 × Charging Cable

1 × User Manual

1 × Retail Box
